notes: Only the minimal Core is stable. Release 0.3.0 replaces the five-level prompt-scaffolding ladder with the schema-4 verification-loop architecture: three modes (lite / standard / critical) that exist for COST and GOVERNANCE only, and a verification loop whose harness-authored, digest-frozen independent checks (acceptance, behavioral differential vs a pre-change baseline, repo-wide symbol sweep, property checks over data, verifier findings) are re-run by the completion gate itself - agent self-attestation never completes a task. Grounding: 6 fixtures / 17 paid calls (incl. the real medi-ny shadow-replay) measured NO correctness lift from prompt scaffolding at 4-10.7x token cost; the corpus finding 'engineer the loop, not the prompt' (F-2026-07-12-009) is now implemented as a mechanism instead of context. The impact-map and adversarial-verification forms are removed. Benchmark verdicts now require >=3 trials/arm (measured ~16pt same-arm variance). The classic router (Router/catalog/modules.json + tools/route.ps1 default path) is unchanged; the adaptive layer stays additive and opt-in via tools/route.ps1 -Adaptive. Runtime/releases/0.3.0/promotion-record.json will be the authoritative promotion timestamp and approver.
